curated.description: Human-curated records, authored or reviewed by a knowledge authority. Highest editorial trust.

acquired.description: Machine-acquired from external sources with per-record provenance (e.g. Wikidata, CLDF). Confidence from the per-source rubric.
acquired.note: Subject to per-record license class — share-alike records ship only in share-alike-labeled partitions.

synthetic.description: Facts from generated fictional worlds (world-producer exports). Complete ground-truth KBs; not real-world claims.
synthetic.containment: Never mixed into real-world tiers; never in open-data releases; training use must be explicitly synthetic-scoped.

personal.description: Facts derived from a user's own files and media (personal-media producer exports). Private by definition.
personal.containment: Never leaves the local machine by default; never in open releases, packaged corpora, non-personal tiers, or non-personal-scoped training sets. Consumers enforce with a hard QA gate.

rules: Every interchange record carries an explicit tier (defaulting is forbidden for synthetic/personal producers).
Tier containment gates are monotone CI checks in every consumer (the convergence-qa ratchet pattern).
Models trained on a tier inherit that tier's distribution constraints; manifests must state the training tier scope.
